name: konoha
description: A squad of Konoha ninja (reusable subagents) that power four dev-workflow skills: /scroll (draft an issue), /mission (ticket to Draft PR), /debrief (resolve the reviews on your PR), and /exam (review a colleague's PR). Inspired by thk, but where thk has one entrypoint, konoha shares one cast across four skills. Naruto-themed skin over a neutral engine.
